verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a programmatic GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live catalog. The models overview and choose-a-model items are human-readable docs pages, not an API endpoint. The general OpenAI-compatibility claims never name a models-listing route, so they cannot be credited for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
